evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Students should use VeriGuide AWD to check the AI index of their assignments before submission. As a general rule,
a higher AI Index indicates a lower level of student effort. If an assignment’s AI Index exceeds 25%, the assignment
may receive a failing grade.

en: Verify course-specific AI rule in each syllabus
Do not use AI for drafting under Approach 2
Follow course instructions for acknowledging any permitted AI assistance
zh: 查阅每门课程大纲的具体 AI 规定
在模式二下严禁使用 AI 起草作业
按照课程指引注明任何获准的 AI 辅助

en: Follow the instructions for the specific examination or assessment
Consult the course examiner or invigilator before assuming AI tools are permitted
zh: 遵循具体考试或考核的指引
在假定允许使用 AI 工具前，咨询主考人或监考人员

en: Submit signed academic honesty declaration where required by course outline (e.g. GECC4130)
Be aware that submissions may be investigated by AI content detection software (VeriGuide AWD)
Follow course instructor instructions for acknowledging any permitted AI use
zh: 按课程大纲要求提交签署的学术诚实声明（如 GECC4130）
知悉作业可能会接受 AI 内容检测软件（VeriGuide AWD）调查
遵循授课教师指引注明任何获准的 AI 使用

en: Apply for Gemini Enterprise if eligible
Migrate from legacy chatbots before Jan 2027
zh: 使用企业 AI 中心提供的服务
如符合资格可申请 Gemini 企业版
在2027年1月前从旧版聊天机器人迁移

en: Log in with CUHK credentials via CADS to consult Schedule 11 in the Research Policy
zh: 通过 CADS 使用中大凭据登录查阅《研究政策》附表11

en: Do not input protected data unless the specific service and use case are approved for that data.
Use CUHK sign-in and check the enterprise data protection indicator; do not infer approval from branding.
zh: 除非特定服务及场景已就该类数据获批，否则不得输入受保护数据。
使用中大账号并核对企业数据保护标识；不可因品牌或标识推定已获审批。

en: Submit full written reasons within 7 working days of notification.
Use the first-instance committee forwarding route unless the original case was handled directly by SCSD.
zh: 在获通知后7个工作日内提交完整书面理由。
除原案由 SCSD 直接处理外，经一审委员会转交申诉。

en: Verify important AI-generated information and follow course instructions.
zh: 核对 AI 生成的重要信息，并遵循课程指引。

en: For API Portal access, follow the application, use-case review and funding requirements.
zh: 申请 API 门户时，遵循申请、用例审查及经费要求。
